command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
export OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first (unlike aarchbio).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== pass 1: serial =="
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee serial.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the serial pass failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'SLEPC OK (serial)' serial.log || { echo "FAIL: no serial sentinel"; exit 1; }

echo
echo "== pass 2: mpiexec -n 2, which also compares against the serial values =="
mpiexec -n 2 python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee mpi.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the 2-rank pass failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'SLEPC OK (mpi2)' mpi.log || { echo "FAIL: no mpi sentinel"; exit 1; }

# one score table: the serial rows plus the parallel-only rows
cp score-serial.tsv score.tsv
awk -F'\t' 'NR>1 && ($1 ~ /^(mpi_ranks|distribution|ownership_rank0|serial_vs_parallel)/)' score-mpi2.tsv >> score.tsv
cat score.tsv

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
